description: Find verified B2B email addresses, phone numbers and company information with Findymail. Discover employees at a known company, check email deliverability, identify contacts from email addresses, and find similar companies. Describe your ideal customer to start a lead-list search, then retrieve its progress and results. Manage account and team exclusion lists to keep selected companies out of future searches. Requires a Findymail account and authentication. Discovery and enrichment tools consume finder credits; email verification uses a separate verifier-credit pool. Exclusion management and retrieval of existing lead-list results consume no additional credits. This app does not send outreach messages.
